name: Nanfang Pump Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Nanfang Pump Industry Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of pump products in China and internationally. It operates through five segments: General Equipment Manufacturing, Environmental Protection Operations, Survey and Design, Environmental Protection Consulting and Engineering, and Waste Resource Comprehensive Utilization.
